data.name: Dreadful Charm Gift
data.description: Once per day when you succeed at a Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidate check against a creature, you can charm that creature as if using charm monster with a caster level equal to your character level. If the creature fails its save, it's charmed for %1 minutes.|TL
